system.description:
Self-taught, with no institution behind you: closer kin to Westfront Fort's outlaw wizards than to any tower.

  • Unexpected Caster: the first harmful spell you cast in a combat where the enemy doesn't expect a caster imposes Disadvantage on their save against it.
    • 9th level: once per encounter, a creature that hasn't seen you cast before has Disadvantage on its save against your first harmful spell.
  • Make It Work: Advantage on checks to scrounge, improvise or substitute spell components on the fly.
